name: sheep
meaning: designer property SHEEP (Scn_GetPropObject prop 0x1c, 0x45ac5d); the sheep this ghost prays to and carries

name: jail
meaning: first CLASSID_JAIL 126 object (Scenaric_FindByClass 0x7e, 0x45ae1e)

name: inflatableSheep
meaning: first CLASSID_INFLATABLESHEEP 132 object, cleared when the search does not return 1 (0x45ad38)

name: ghostCostume
meaning: first CLASSID_GHOSTCOSTUME 125 object, cleared when the search does not return 1 (0x45ad61)

name: checkpoint
meaning: designer property CHECKPOINT (prop 0x0c, 0x45ac49); gets message 0x1080 from state 14

name: camRestrict1
meaning: designer property CAMERARESTRICTION1 (prop 0x00) - gets message 0xd80 with 0/1

name: camRestrict2
meaning: designer property CAMERARESTRICTION2 (prop 0x04)

name: camRestrict3
meaning: designer property CAMERARESTRICTION3 (prop 0x08)

name: fallingGate
meaning: designer property FALLINGGATE (prop 0x14) - gets message 0x1f from state 5

name: fallingGateDetec
meaning: designer property FALLINGGATEDETEC (prop 0x18) - gets message 0x20 when the trajectory ends

name: noticed
meaning: the object handed with message 0x5e (0x45d78d); classId 0x65 makes it the chase target

name: target
meaning: who this ghost chases in states 12/13: `noticed` when its classId is 0x65, else g_pWolf (0x45cee7-0x45cf20)

name: monoHideBoxes
meaning: designer property WOLFNOTVISIBLEMONO (prop 0x34) resolved through Scn_FindIdList (0x45adb9)

name: wolfHideBoxes
meaning: designer property WOLFINVISIBLE1 (prop 0x30) resolved through Scn_FindIdList (0x45adf0)

name: followSelf
meaning: TrajFollower_Init(this, ..., speed 300, bias 0x800, arrive 50) over the TRAJECTORY property (0x45ae81)

name: followWolf
meaning: second follower over the same trajectory - stepped with g_pWolf as the mover (0x45c18f)

name: followSheep
meaning: third follower over the same trajectory - stepped with g_prayingGhosts[2] as the mover (0x45c235)

name: trajectory
meaning: designer property TRAJECTORY (Scn_GetPropTrajectory prop 0x2c) - u16 count then Vec3s points from +2

name: turnHeading
meaning: heading turned a quarter of the way per call by PrayingGhost_TurnToHeading 0x45e100

name: startBox
meaning: designer property STARTBOX (Scn_GetPropBox prop 0x24)

name: sheepBox
meaning: designer property SHEEPBOX (Scn_GetPropBox prop 0x20)

name: trajCount
meaning: trajectory[0] - the number of trajectory points (0x45af05)

name: trajFirst
meaning: first trajectory point (0x45af1b)

name: trajLast
meaning: last trajectory point: trajectory + 2 + (count-1)*6 (0x45af3c)

name: halo
meaning: a second animated body built from exported resource 0xbf; its vtables are constructed by the factory at 0x45e516 and it is drawn before the ghost's own body (0x45dffe)

name: haloRecord
meaning: the synthetic WAR record Scn_BuildRecordFromExport(0xbf, ...) writes for the halo body (0x45b06f)

name: haloValid
meaning: 1 when the halo record was built and the halo body initialised (0x45b0ae)

name: haloVisible
meaning: 1 while the halo body is drawn (set in state 13 at 0x45df22; tested by Render 0x45dff5)

name: chaseDelta
meaning: target minus mover; the working vector of every chase step (0x45bbe5)

name: chaseVel
meaning: chaseDelta scaled to speed 200 on x and z, 0 vertical (0x45bc44)

name: chaseStep
meaning: Vec3s_ScaleByDt(chaseVel) - the per-frame translation (0x45bca1)

name: homePos
meaning: the object's position at PostLoadInit; the respawn point (0x45af6e)

name: postPos
meaning: the ghost's post on the trajectory: trajFirst offset by 0x1f4 / 0 / 0xf5 / 0x15e on x by index (0x45d534-0x45d65b)

name: sheepHome
meaning: centre of SHEEPBOX in x/z, ground height there from the sheep's own collision box (0x45ac88)

name: wolfCapturePos
meaning: g_pWolf->pos snapshotted when the capture starts (states 4 and 8)

name: sheepCapturePos
meaning: sheep->pos snapshotted when state 6 starts (0x45dde6)

name: state
meaning: PrayingGhost_SetState's argument; 0..14, the Update switch

name: index
meaning: this ghost's slot: the argument of message 0x4505, also its index into g_prayingGhosts and g_ghostAtPost

name: wolfLift
meaning: vertical offset added to wolfCapturePos.y while the Wolf is carried; steps by -10 until |wolfLift| >= 100

name: sheepLift
meaning: same for the sheep in state 6; steps by -10 while 300 - |sheepCapturePos.y| > |sheepLift|

name: prayDurMs
meaning: Anim_GetDurationMs(anim 4) - the length of the praying animation (0x45b037)

name: grabDurMs
meaning: Anim_GetDurationMs(anim 10) - the length of the grab animation (0x45b053)

name: alertDelayMs
meaning: designer property TIMEORANGE (prop 0x28) - how long the ghost may see the Wolf before alertLevel goes to 1

name: timer
meaning: countdown in g_dtMs units: the praying cycle in state 10 and the grab in state 13

name: sheepGraceMs
meaning: 2000 ms grace after the sheep enters SHEEPBOX before the ghosts are told (message 0x4501)

name: trajHeading
meaning: heading written by TrajFollower_Step (0x45c0ce)

name: registered
meaning: 1 once message 0x4505 has placed this ghost in g_prayingGhosts (0x45d4f9)

name: isLeader
meaning: set only on the ghost with index 1 (0x45d4ec); that one drives the cinematic capture

name: praying
meaning: 1 in state 10 (the praying loop) and 0 in states 1 and 12

name: wolfHidden
meaning: 1 when the Wolf's position is inside one of monoHideBoxes or wolfHideBoxes (0x45cb9e)

name: sheepBoxOccupied
meaning: 1 when ObjGrid_QueryBoxOverlap on SHEEPBOX returned something that is not a sheep (0x45b6c0)

name: sheepDecoySeen
meaning: 1 when an InflatableSheep is in SHEEPBOX (0x45b684)

name: decoyAccepted
meaning: 1 when the InflatableSheep accepted message 0x4601 (0x45b674)

name: graceArmed
meaning: 1 while the sheep-gone grace period is counting (0x45b767)

name: trajDone
meaning: 1 when the cinematic trajectory has been walked to its end (0x45c2c3)

name: watching
meaning: 1 in state 10 (the ghost is at its post and watching) and 0 in state 1

name: sheepStolen
meaning: 1 once the sheep has been seen leaving STARTBOX (0x45b2c4); cleared when the capture reaches the Wolf

name: iconBufToggle
meaning: alternates the two icon primitive buffers handed to ScnBody_RenderEx (0x45e3ea)

name: iconPrimBuf
meaning: two 0x190-byte primitive blocks for the head-icon draw (same shape as Watch::hudPrimBuf)

name: alertLevel
meaning: index into g_samZoneColors for the head icon: 0 white / 1 orange (0x45e49c)

name: alertBoxes
meaning: id list 0x45 - while the Wolf stands in one of these boxes the ghost does not notice him (0x45b0ca)
